draft_key_information_units.information: Record revenue growth of 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m) driven by scaling of the Transport Series, with EBITDA up 26% to DKK 31.1m and EBT surging 109% to DKK 19.0m.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table and Financial Performance section detailing year-over-year growth metrics.

draft_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 was the strongest quarter in company history with revenue of DKK 40.96m (+106% QoQ), led by Farm Manager (DKK 11.7m), Truck Manager (DKK 8.99m), and Airline Manager (DKK 10.25m).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Q4 Financial Performance section showing quarterly revenue breakdown and growth rates.

draft_key_information_units.information: In-App Advertising (IAA) revenue doubled to DKK 18.48m (2024: DKK 9.23m) following strategic optimization initiatives initiated in late September 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue Mix Expansion section detailing IAA growth and optimization timeline.

draft_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, up from 35% revenue and 25% EBITDA in 2024.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section analyzing title-specific revenue contributions.

draft_key_information_units.information: Farm Manager launched in July 2025 with 5 million pre-registrations, contributing DKK 22.0m in its first six months and becoming a top-grossing title.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Farm Manager section in Portfolio Overview detailing launch metrics and revenue.

draft_key_information_units.information: 2026 guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%), EBITDA of DKK 28-36m (-10% to -16%), and EBT of DKK 18-24m (-12% to -17%), contingent on marketing efficiency and monetization scaling.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section providing full-year financial targets and key assumptions.

draft_key_information_units.information: Robust financial position with 78% solvency ratio, total equity of DKK 66.1m, and zero interest-bearing debt; cash position improved to DKK 36.4m by 31 January 2026 after year-end adjustments.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Performance section on capital structure and Liquidity dynamics.

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic pipeline includes Train Manager 2 (flagship release) and Space Manager (galactic-scale exploration), with four major projects planned for the 2027+ horizon.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 and Milestones in 2025 sections outlining product roadmap.

draft_key_information_units.information: Completion of DKK 5m share buy-back program repurchasing 458,572 shares at an average price of DKK 10.89, holding 3.87% treasury shares as of 31 December 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Share buy-back program details in Financial Review and Shareholder Information.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units prioritize headline financial performance (D1-D2), major performance drivers (D3-D5), liquidity/capital position (D7), and strategic outlook (D6, D8) per evaluation criteria. D4-D5 highlight portfolio dynamics, while D9 covers material capital allocation. All units are independently omittable themes central to understanding financial health, operational success, and future strategy. REFERENCE SUMMARY informed salience of growth metrics, Big 3 titles, and 2026 guidance, but units are derived exclusively from SOURCE content.
